messages:
tian: Proposal: bump audit event schema to v2. Main changes: replace actor_email -> actor_id, add customer_id, add event_hash for immutability, drop legacy 'session_name'. Need versioning + migration plan for consumers. Thoughts?
alex: Should we keep actor_email available as optional for a while? Some of our enterprise customers still ingest it.
tian: Plan is dual-write for 4w: emit both actor_id and actor_email while adding top-level schema_version. After 4w we'll mark actor_email deprecated and then remove in the final cut. Example payload below: 
```
{
  "schema_version": "2",
  "event_type": "auth.login",
  "actor_id": "u-12345",
  "customer_id": "c-67890",
  "event_hash": "sha256:..."
}
```
mira: Legal note: storing customer_id is fine, but actor_email is PII. If we keep it in exports we need redaction options and clear consent. KMS: do we plan to encrypt the PII fields in the audit stream? We should avoid plaintext in customer-facing webhooks.
tian: Agree. Proposed compromise: store actor_email only as a hashed field 'actor_email_hash' using per-customer HMAC via KMS-derived key so consumers can correlate but not read email. @sofia can ingestion compute/verify the hash?
sofia: Yes — ingest-service can compute HMAC with a per-customer key. We will need a KMS call on key rotation; that may add ~200ms. If we need sub-50ms SLO, we should make hashing async and add an enrichment step.
alex: On versioning: consumers should declare supported_versions in the schema registry. Producers tag every event with schema_version. Rollout behind FF 'audit_schema_v2' then flip. Consumers accept v1 and v2 during migration window.
tian: Rollout plan (draft): 1) publish v2 schema in registry + changelog; 2) update producers to emit schema_version=2 behind feature flag and dual-write both formats; 3) enable dual-read support in all downstream consumers; 4) monitor validation errors (send alerts to #eng-security); 5) increase traffic to v2 canary over 2w; 6) toggle for all orgs after stable; 7) deprecate v1 after 8w. Feedback?
mira: Please add customer communication: Compliance needs 30-day notice and sample webhook payloads. Also need an opt-out for customers who cannot accept hashed identifiers.
alex: Migration checklist additions: add schema-registry entry, publish migration-runbook.md, update contract tests, schedule 1% canary for 48h, create dashboard for invalid_event_rate and consumer_error_rate. Postmortem hook if invalid_event_rate > 0.5% in first week.
sofia: Tests: add contract tests to CI that run consumers against both v1 and v2 payloads. Can we add a canary routing rule to direct 1% of traffic to the v2 path immediately?
tian: Yes. Also RBAC implications: only principals with 'audit_view' can request reverse-mapping from actor_id -> actor_email. That mapping should be an audited action (meta-audit event) and gated by customer consent. @mira ok?
mira: Consent ok if explicit. Default behavior for webhook exports: do not include reverse mapping. Also require an audit event whenever someone requests a reverse mapping.
deploy-bot: deploy queued: audit-producer v2 feature-flag -> canary (1%)
alex: :thumbsup: I'll draft the runbook and PRs. Will add sample HMAC code snippet.
tian: I'll own the rollout schedule and public changelog. Will post sample payloads and the runbook by EOD tomorrow. Thanks everyone!
